newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker prices stable, focus on SIMEX.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker prices stable, focus on SIMEX.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were stable on Tuesday but sentiment was cautious with the market focused on Singapore International Monetary Exchange's (SIMEX) re-launch of a revised fuel oil futures contract, traders said.
Bunker 180-CST and 380-CST grades were quoted at around Monday's levels of $103 and $97 per tonne respectively.
"There's no significant change in either demand or supply. The market is waiting to see how the cargo market will react to SIMEX futures," said one trader.
